Capa detects 4 rules: anti-VM (T1497.001), ASPack packing (T1027.002), embedded PE drop (B0023), and PDB path. 20 anomalies reported by Malcat. Persistence capabilities are not observed; no evidence from Capa analysis (rule detection) indicates persistence techniques, and Malcat anomalies (20 reported) do not specify persistence mechanisms (source: Capa, Malcat). Exfiltration capabilities are not observed; the sample focuses on payload delivery and evasion, with no data exfiltration indicators in Capa detections or Malcat anomalies (source: Capa, Malcat).
